documentation.file_docstring:
Plugin quality scoring model — separate from trust/compliance scoring.

Trust tiers answer 'is this plugin safe?'
Quality scoring answers 'is this plugin good?'
inline_comments: Update existing dimension or add new
member_docstrings: QualityDimension: Dimensions along which plugin quality is assessed.
QualityBadge: Badge tiers awarded based on overall quality score.
QualityScore: Quality assessment for a single dimension.
PluginQualityProfile: Aggregated quality profile for a plugin.
QualityStore: In-memory store for plugin quality profiles.
overall_score: Return the mean score across all assessed dimensions.
badge: Derive a badge from the overall score.
get_score: Return the score for a specific dimension, or ``None`` if unrated.
record_score: Record (or update) a quality score for a plugin dimension.
get_profile: Retrieve the quality profile for a specific plugin version.
